description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Thief Mode I: Faris], [Twin Element Mode II (Fire, Wind)] and [Wind/Fire Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Thief Mode I: Faris
description.text: Thief abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Thief abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Thief abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Thief abilities

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Fire, Wind)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Wind with Stacking] after using a Fire/Wind ability

description.name: Wind/Fire Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Wind and Fire abilities deal 5% more damage

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Thief Mode II: Faris] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Thief Mode I: Faris] from the user
